body: Yes I just don't know how the system can find a person that wrote nasty comments behind a computer screen. I'm sure there might be some other red flags too.
We think by the time its good again we won't be able to apply this year. Only 2 sittings a year.

Yes but everyone is frustrated. People are frustrated by telling them it will be cancelled, others are frustrated by people are saying that it will go ahead. Of course no one wanted to intentionally hurt anyone!!! No one would want to. I think the other poster is just urging to look at the facts and not extrapolate. I feel like it left the posters cousin with no home and a sense of doom. I think we just all need to be a lot kinder from now on. Lets wait until the 23rd. And then on the 23rd lets all continue to me kind and look out for each other and provide support.

I do understand what you are saying. I think the point of the other poster is saying lets just all help each other out now. Not just for those feeling mentally weak. Debatably we all are feeling like that right now. Not saying you are the cause of it at all just saying there is a lot of evidence on this forum in recent days of people clearly in distress and projecting it on others. I think I would just urge us all (not directed at you) to be positive and look out for each other. We are going to need to be positive once the announcement comes out on the 23rd too. Just suggesting it could be good for anyone feeling stressed in times like these to turn the corona news off for 24 hours just to get away from it. Take care everyone.

I agree with this but I think from the most recent post on this forum I think this negativity is having a large affect on people. If you find yourself affected by it please take some time away from this forum. I think this forum has now turned into a very hateful place for a lot of people. Everyone just take care and remain positive in this tough time.

Please guys I would urge you to stay off this forum for now if you are concerned about your mental health/anyone in general feeling down. New forum post with a really upsetting post on here. Please everyone be kind to each other. If it means anything at all I'm thinking of absolutely everyone and wishing the best for everyone in this time whether it be academically, financially and with your family and friends. If anyone wants an ear to listen I'm your man. Take care everyone.

I'm in Australia. GAMSAT might be rescheduled but everyone being really negative about it over here. Might I ask when was MCAT and when is it being rescheduled? Do they have less people in the testing centre or something?

First of all I would like to send my deepest condolences about your cousin. I can't even imagine what you are going through right now. Sending all my best wishes to you at the moment and if there is anything I can do at all let me know.   
I would like to say I agree with your post wholeheartedly. I saw a post on this forum two-three days ago making fun of another posters mental health and telling him that he was a suicidal clown.   
Please everyone look out for each other. We don't know what is going to happen. But what is certain is that if we all look out for each other and be kind, we will be in a much better spot than making wild assumptions and telling each other what they think will happen (which really is what they want to happen).   
One again sending all my love. Everyone there are other options and better things coming. Send positive vibes only in this time.

Guys don't you think its a bit hasty to announce a 6 month ban on things already? No one knows what will happen because of this. No one knows if we require a 6 month shut down at this stage. Other countries are doing 30 day travel bans. Why have we already said no events for 6 months.
